model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different language families on various models, comparing the performance across nine distinct language families. The horizontal axis represents the language families, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" and ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5 and minor ticks at intervals of 1. The chart contains grouped bars, with each group representing a language family and consisting of six bars corresponding to different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in light blue, blue, light green, green, pink, and red, respectively. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as listed in the legend, with varying heights indicating different effects. The height of the bars across the different language families and models ranges from approximately 0 to 26, with IE-Indic showing the highest effect for mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2 models, at around 22 and 26, respectively, and Isolate and Uralic generally having lower effects across all models. Error bars are present on top of each bar, indicating the variability or uncertainty in the measured effects. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within each group or across the different language families.
